note: Big South Fork's main campground beside the Bandy Creek Visitor Center, camp store and stables: four loops (A-D) plus two group loops; swimming pool open weekends and holidays from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Highway 297 from Oneida drops into the river gorge on a 13% grade with sharp curves; the park suggests Highway 154 instead for anyone uncomfortable with that. --Claude
